notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Viridian Joiner +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Viridian Joiner.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.
